name: restcraft
description: Create, manage, and execute API requests from file-based definitions using a Postman-like interface inside Visual Studio Code.

restcraft.requestTimeout.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for an API request. Set to 0 to disable the timeout.

restcraft.suppressInsecureCredentialWarn.description: Do not warn before sending authentication credentials to remote servers over unencrypted HTTP.

restcraft.showEnvironmentVariableValues.description: Show resolved .env values in tooltips when hovering over {{VARIABLE}} references in request fields.

restcraft.autoGenerateAuthorizationCodeS.description: Automatically generate state for new authorization code flows when selecting Authorization Code in the Authorization tab, only if State is empty. Existing State values are preserved.

enumDescriptions: Show the decoded JWT header and payload.
restcraft.defaultTokenView.description: Token output view to select when opening the Authorization tab. Retrieving tokens preserves the selected view.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.check: npm run lint -- --max-warnings=0 && npm run format:check && npm run check-types
